issues.body: The diff adds Store.validateStore and store_validateStore only to sparq_wasm.d.ts. No corresponding generated JS glue, wasm artifact/source change, or focused runtime test appears in the diff, and the checkout contains no non-declaration validateStore implementation. TypeScript consumers can therefore compile calls to store.validateStore(...), but the shipped Store object will not implement that method. The unrelated API addition also makes this picker-focused PR incomplete as published.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the validateStore-related generated declaration changes from this PR. If the API is intentional, regenerate and commit the complete wasm-bindgen output from the matching Rust implementation and add a focused runtime test that instantiates Store and calls validateStore; ship that as a separately scoped public-API change with the required surface documentation.
issues.title: Generated declaration exposes a runtime method that this PR does not provide

verdict.summary: The file-picker change remains coherent and its focused tests still cover the raw-File, cancellation, fallback, option-forwarding, and partial-failure contracts approved in round 1. However, round 2 introduces an unrelated generated declaration for Store.validateStore without the corresponding generated JavaScript/wasm implementation anywhere in this change. That makes the published TypeScript surface claim a callable method that will be absent at runtime. This is a new major finding, so progress is regressing.
